source_excerpt:

NBC will celebrate Alan Jackson ‘s long career and final concert performance with Alan Jackson: The Last Show , a two-hour special will airing at 8 p.m. December 8. It will stream next day on Peacock .
Filmed before a sold-out crowd at Nashville’s Nissan Stadium in June, the special will honor the country star’s enduring legacy and impact on generations of fans and musicians alike as he takes the stage one final time. Jackson will perform many of his greatest hits, including “Chattahoochee,” “It’s Five O’Clock Somewhere,” “Remember When,” “Gone Country” and “Livin’ on Love.”

The special also will include performances and appearances from the likes of Luke Bryan, Eric Church, Luke Combs, Riley Green, Cody Johnson, Miranda Lambert, Little Big Town, Jake Owen, Jon Pardi, Thomas Rhett, Carrie Underwood, Lainey Wilson, Lee Ann Womack, Adam Wright, Big City Brian Wright and Carlisle Wright and will feature a pair of duets by Jackson and George Strait. Watch on Deadline
Directed by Sam Wrench, Alan Jackson: The Last Show is produced by Joan of Arc StudioWorks and EverWonder Studio. Cindy Mabe, Dawn Gates and Harper Grae executive produce for Joan of Arc StudioWorks along with Mike Antinoro and Raj Kapoor for EverWonder Studio. Jackson, Debbie Doebler and RAC Clark also executive produce. Co-executive producers are Allison Roithinger, Victoria Chamlee and Danny Meiseles for EverWonder Studio.
